What cookies are

Cookies are small text files stored on your device by websites. Similar technologies, such as local storage, work in comparable ways. This page explains what this website stores and how you can control it.

What this website actually uses

We audited this website's code. At the time of writing it uses no cookies and no third-party scripts. Fonts are hosted on our own server, so your browser does not contact a font provider. There are no embedded videos, maps, social feeds or chat widgets.

Cookie categories

Necessary

Needed for the site to work or to remember your own choices. Do not require consent. None are currently set.

Analytics

Would measure how visitors use the site (for example Google Analytics). Not in use. If introduced, they will only run after you opt in.

Marketing

Would be used for advertising and remarketing (for example Meta Pixel or LinkedIn Insight Tag). Not in use. If introduced, they will only run after you opt in.

Third-party

Set by external services embedded in pages. None are used.

Why there is no cookie banner

A consent banner is only needed when optional cookies or trackers are used. Because none are, this demo shows no banner and does not load anything that would need consent. If optional tools are added later, the site should block them until a visitor opts in, with choices that are not pre-selected, as shown in the preferences panel below.

LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: Confirm consent obligations for your audience (for example visitors in Pakistan, India and any other regions) before adding analytics or advertising tags.

Managing cookies in your browser

You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Look for “Cookies” or “Site data” in the privacy or security section of Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge or your mobile browser. Blocking necessary storage may affect parts of a site.

Changes to this policy

We will update this policy if we add or remove any cookie or tracking technology. Last updated: 7 October 2026. For how we handle personal information more broadly, see our Privacy Policy.
